rationale: The momentum-short thesis has stalled — price is basing above the 9-EMA ($10.46) and 5-min VWAP ($10.38) on fading volume with no new supply pulse, while the take-profit at $10.15 sits ~16 ATRs away with only 28 minutes left in a dead tape. Meanwhile the $10.53 stop is just a few cents above a shelf that is holding, making a late-day bounce the likelier stop-out path than a fade reaching target in the remaining session. The micro evidence is not nearly strong enough to justify a long flip against the still-dominant session downtrend and the 38 bps spread, so flattening at a minimal loss is the cleanest choice.
